nodes.label: Circuit breakers (3 files/step, typecheck gate, stop for approval)
nodes.rationale: Bounded steps with a human gate: max 3 files per step, zero typecheck errors before claiming completion, update LLM_STATE.md and STOP, never commit without approval, no ghost dependencies.

nodes.label: No hardcoding rule
nodes.rationale: Provider ids/labels live only in src/lib/providers.ts and env-derived values only in src/config, with types derived from that single source; MVP-first means minimal entries but scalable machinery.

nodes.label: Bun-first mandate (Bun-native and Web-standard APIs)
nodes.rationale: Bun runs everything and Next starts via bun --bun so Bun-native APIs work at runtime: WebCrypto over node:crypto, Uint8Array hex/base64 over Buffer, Bun.$ over child_process; a node:* import is allowed only where Bun ships no equivalent, e.g. node:stream for pino.

nodes.label: Drizzle over libSQL driver with explicit migrations
nodes.rationale: One client serves a local file: dev path and a remote Turso libsql:// URL. Migrations run only via the explicit db:migrate step because libsql's migrator is async while getDb() is synchronous, and auto-migrating per connection let concurrent Next.js build workers race on the same database.

nodes.label: Configuration mandate: src/config/index.ts only
nodes.rationale: App identity, server, API version, database URL, vault key, asset paths, theme and observability all flow through one exported config object; process.env is never read anywhere else.

nodes.label: Zod validates all external input at the API boundary
nodes.rationale: Request bodies, query params and Ray callbacks are validated before touching the database or vault; shared schemas live in src/lib/schemas.ts.

nodes.label: Biome for lint+format, tsc only for typecheck
nodes.rationale: ESLint and Prettier are banned; tsc --noEmit is retained purely as the typecheck gate because Biome does not type-check and Bun has no typechecker.

nodes.label: UI rule: ShadCN components and HugeIcons only
nodes.rationale: No native form elements and no Lucide; every page build runs through the design-taste-frontend, gpt-taste, ui-styling and ui-ux-pro-max skills to avoid templated AI-slop layouts.

nodes.label: Vivid UI and living-app motion
nodes.rationale: No dead surfaces: each control gets its own hover accent plus motion feedback, and app-level state changes use the View Transitions API so a big change feels physical, always gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Generous scale (desktop command center sizing)
nodes.rationale: Buttons >= h-9, inputs >= h-10, real row padding, h-16 headers, p-8 content: use the screen space rather than cramped micro-UI.

nodes.label: Light mode and mobile are first-class
nodes.rationale: Tailwind -300/-200 shades read on near-black but wash out on white, so they need a paired darker light-mode shade; data-active/data-state primitives bake their own variants so an outside utility class loses on specificity and the override must use the matching data-attribute prefix. Verify both themes and ~390x844 with agent-browser.

nodes.label: Solid colors only, no glass
nodes.rationale: No translucent tints, blurred glow shadows or backdrop-blur; accents use a solid fill instead of an opacity fraction over the background.

nodes.label: Layout must not dance while loading
nodes.rationale: A skeleton mirrors the real component and reserves every element's height so nothing moves between loading and loaded; client-only values render a same-sized placeholder.

nodes.label: Fixed-viewport dashboard shell
nodes.rationale: The (dashboard) shell never scrolls (h-svh overflow-hidden on SidebarInset) and only ShellContent's ScrollArea does; overflow must not be set globally on html/body because setting overflow-y on both disables html->body scroll propagation and public pages get a double scrollbar.

nodes.label: Row-scoped actions rule
nodes.rationale: Operations on an existing record (reconnect, delete) live in that record's row; the page header holds only creation actions.

nodes.label: Code hygiene: 250-line cap and backend naming
nodes.rationale: Split modules before 250 lines; there is exactly ONE Hono app and everything under src/server/ is a module, never a sub-router named app.

nodes.label: Rays are provider-generic (registry, generic account_* keys)
nodes.rationale: Flows go through src/server/ray-providers.ts with no provider-specific routes, cookies or strings in flow logic; registry entries map provider vocabulary onto generic account_id/name/email/avatar keys so vault, routes and UI consume only generic keys.

nodes.label: Security rule: encrypted tokens, plaintext meta_data, never logged
nodes.rationale: access_token/refresh_token are AES-256-GCM encrypted with a unique IV per record while meta_data stays plaintext JSON for queryability; tokens, keys and request bodies are never logged.

nodes.label: Brand logo linking rule
nodes.rationale: Always the PNG from config.assets.logo; public pages link to /, the dashboard shell links to /runs so a signed-in user clicking the logo is never bounced to the marketing page.
